title: stack_resolved golden test flakes due to game_end snapshot race
body:
The stack_resolved golden test intermittently fails in CI with snapshot count differences (17 vs 16 items) and zeroed-out player state at the last snapshot (library_size=0, hand=0, graveyard=0).

Root cause: race condition between onPlayerResponse() and onGameEnd() in ServerGameEventLogCollector. The game_end event emits a final state snapshot (line ~261), but the game state may be partially cleared by the time it's captured. Thread scheduling differences between local and CI environments make this nondeterministic.

The export pipeline (export_game.py:508-548) collects snapshots from both decision events and game_end events into the same snapshots array. When the game_end snapshot captures a cleared/invalid state, the golden comparison fails.

Possible fixes:
- Skip game_end snapshots where player zones are zeroed (heuristic)
- Ensure onGameEnd captures the last valid game state before cleanup
- Add snapshot deduplication by seq number in the export pipeline
